phase_fields.description: Type of phase field (number of elements) to investigate

method.description: Unsupervised model: VAE / AE (PyOD) or VAE_encoder (Keras VAE with latent features)

features.description: Elemental feature set (a file name in the bundled data/elemental_features, e.g. magpie, oliynyk, mat2vec, megnet16, ...)

icsd_file.description: Bundled ICSD excerpt used as the training set of known phase fields

cations_train.description: Cations allowed in the training phase fields ('all' for every element)

anions_train.description: Anions (negative oxidation-state elements) in the training set

nanions_train.description: Number of anions in the training phase fields (0 ignores oxidation states)

cation1_test.description: Elements for the 1st (cation) position of the phase fields to rank

cation2_test.description: Elements for the 2nd position (quaternary only; ignored for ternary MAA')

anion1_test.description: Elements for the 3rd position of the phase fields to rank

anion2_test.description: Elements for the 4th position (quaternary only; ignored for ternary)

average_runs.description: Number of runs to average scores over (meaningful for non-neural methods)

rank.description: Train an unsupervised model on ICSD phase-field patterns and rank the requested unexplored phase fields by similarity to known chemistry (likelihood of hosting a stable compound). The study is defined by the model parameters.

rankings.csv.description: Ranked phase fields with raw and normalised similarity scores

top_ranked.description: Most-promising phase fields (lowest score = most similar to known chemistry)

score.description: Reconstruction-error score (lower = more similar to ICSD)
